persistentLabel: 固定合成材料；证据类型随场景标明 / Fixed synthetic material; evidence type labeled by scene

lines: External model not called; human value and production security unvalidated
Snapshot checks; delivery is not atomic with chain state
closingDisclosure.placement: A dedicated readable card beside captions, not tiny footer text. Detail remains in docs/EVIDENCE.md.

scenes.chinese: 我把给 AI 的要求从“简短结论”改成“详细解释”。下一位助手，还能收到旧版本吗？
scenes.english: I changed my instruction from “brief conclusions” to “detailed explanations.” Can the next assistant still receive the old version?
scenes.screen: 简短结论 → 本次详细解释 / Brief → Detailed

scenes.chinese: 这是山海连续性协议。它保留内容来源：在协议测试中，用户认可 AI 推断，也不会把它变成用户原话。
scenes.english: This is Shanhai Continuity Protocol. Our protocol tests preserve source: Even when a user accepts an AI inference, it does not become their own words.
scenes.screen: MODEL_INFERENCE remains MODEL_INFERENCE; reviewStatus becomes USER_CONFIRMED. 明显标注：独立的本地合成协议测试 / Separate local synthetic protocol test.

scenes.chinese: 正文加密留在链外，授权和版本记录在 Monad。发送方与接收方各自核验，接收方不必只相信山海服务器的回答。
scenes.english: Encrypted content stays off-chain. Monad records authorization and versions. Sender and recipient each verify that record. The recipient need not rely only on our server.
scenes.screen: Encrypted content off-chain ↔ Owner check → Monad authorization/version record ← Agent B check. 两次读取为区块快照，并非原子交付。

scenes.chinese: 看这次测试网记录：用户只授权一条偏好，私密备注未进入上下文。授权有效时，独立接收进程解密，并把获准材料组装进上下文。
scenes.english: In this recorded testnet run, only one preference was authorized. A private note stayed out of context. With valid authorization, a separate recipient process decrypted and assembled the approved material into context.
scenes.screen: ACTIVE_CONTEXT_DELIVERED / ACTIVE. Show the selected preference, excluded note and measured Owner/B execution increments; label Agent B as a separate local process.

scenes.chinese: 用户随后更正为“这次需要详细解释”。发布第二版后，旧请求被阻断，没有新增取材、解密或上下文组装。
scenes.english: The user then changed the instruction: “This task needs a detailed explanation.” After version two was published, the old request was denied: no new material fetch, decryption, or context assembly.
scenes.screen: V2: detailed explanation. DENIED / VERSION_STALE; no new fetch/decrypt/context/gateway. No new V2 grant or delivery is shown.

scenes.chinese: 撤销授权后，下一次请求也在交付前停止。此前合法取得的明文无法追回；原型约束的是后续交付。
scenes.english: After revocation, the next request was also stopped before delivery. Previously received plaintext cannot be reclaimed. This prototype controls subsequent delivery.
scenes.screen: DENIED / REVOKED; downstream increments 0. Previously delivered plaintext cannot be reclaimed.

scenes.chinese: 三种结果、四笔状态交易，都能沿链上记录和执行回执核查。
scenes.english: Three outcomes and four state transactions can be checked against on-chain records and execution receipts.
scenes.screen: Three outcomes / four state transactions. Permission state: on-chain. Execution counters: project instrumentation. Hash match checks archive identity; it is not external reproduction.

scenes.chinese: 山海连续性协议：让下一次交付，先核验授权。
scenes.english: Shanhai Continuity Protocol: verify authorization before the next delivery.
scenes.screen: Shanhai Continuity Protocol. Verify authorization before the next delivery.

captions.english:
I changed my instruction from “brief conclusions”
to “detailed explanations.”

Can the next assistant still receive
the old version?

This is Shanhai Continuity Protocol.
Our protocol tests preserve source:

Even when a user accepts an AI inference,
it does not become their own words.

Encrypted content stays off-chain.
Monad records authorization and versions.

Sender and recipient each verify that record.
The recipient need not rely only on our server.

In this recorded testnet run, only one preference
was authorized. A private note stayed out of context.

With valid authorization, a separate recipient process
decrypted and assembled the approved material into context.

The user then changed the instruction:
“This task needs a detailed explanation.”

After version two was published, the old request was denied:
no new material fetch, decryption, or context assembly.

After revocation, the next request was also
stopped before delivery.

Previously received plaintext cannot be reclaimed.
This prototype controls subsequent delivery.

Three outcomes and four state transactions can be checked
against on-chain records and execution receipts.

Shanhai Continuity Protocol:
verify authorization before the next delivery.
